title: feat(spec,lint,app-shell)!: a field group's relatedList names body tables only
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgpxjnsDPHLokR644U

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB4nF3VoKUasRdU6J4QcFgy4)_

Fixes #27478

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` teaches `fieldGroups[].relatedList`; `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md` and `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` teach only the FK's own `relatedList`, whose meaning does not change.

**Seat ruling on #27478: option B (narrowing).** Whether a related list is a body table is decided once, by the relationship's own keys on the child's FK (`relatedList: 'primary'`, or a `master_detail` that sets `inlineEdit` and declares no `relatedList`), per ruling B on #27055. A field group's `relatedList` only positions a body table; it never promotes a side card. Option A would give body-ness two sources that can disagree (the FK saying side card, the group saying body). So a group naming a relationship that is not a body table is refused, with a prescription, and Studio offers only body tables.

**Landing order.** PR #27352 rewrites the same `fieldGroups[i].relatedList` describe and docblock. Per the seat, #27352 landed first and this PR writes its text on top of #27352's wording, replacing only its "`relatedList: false` still hides the table" sentence. No other #27352 line is touched.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：新增 `@objectstack/spec` 的唯一判定 `isBodyTableRelationship`（这个子关系是不是记录页的主表）；field group 的 `relatedList` 指向侧栏卡片或被隐藏的关系时，`defineStack` 和对象写入口（lint 规则 `related-list-group-not-body`）都会拒绝并给出改法；Studio 只列主表；记录页、Studio 和拒绝读同一个判定。
- 为什么改：以前这种分组能保存、能发布，但记录页在分组位置什么都不画，静默失效；Studio 还会主动给出这种选项。
- 风险与回滚：BREAKING 只针对一种写法（分组指向非主表），仓库内示例、平台对象、dogfood 和 HotCRM 都没有这种写法；已存行照常加载，下次保存会 422。另有一格行为变化：`master_detail` + `inlineEdit` + `relatedList: true` 现在是侧栏卡片（与该键的说明一致）。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/data/related-list-body-table.ts`（判定与拒绝句），`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`（`collectRelatedListNameErrors` 内的调用），`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectGroupInspector.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/data/related-list-body-table.test.ts src/stack-related-lists-order.test.ts`，应全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位负责落地。

## What changes

### Measured first, on `origin/main` 273137d2

An object whose field group names a relationship that is not a body table parsed, passed `defineStack` and the object write door, and drew nothing at the group. A probe over six child shapes (a plain `lookup`, `lookup` with `relatedList: true`, `lookup` with `relatedList: false`, a `master_detail` with no `inlineEdit`, and two body-table controls) answered the same for all six: `ObjectSchema.safeParse: true`, `defineStack: accepted`, `door errors: []`. `buildDefaultTabs` (plugin-detail) drew `details(basic,terms)` with `record:related_list(task)` left in Related, so a group naming `task` placed nothing.

The record page also had two copies of the rule. app-shell `isMainContentList` (behind `deriveRelatedLists`' `isPrimary` and Studio's relationship inspector) counted `'primary'`, or a `master_detail` with `inlineEdit` and no `relatedList`. `RecordDetailView`'s `isBody` was `isPrimary` OR `master_detail` + `inlineEdit`, which ignored `relatedList: true`.

### One predicate

`isBodyTableRelationship(field)` in `packages/spec/src/data/related-list-body-table.ts`, exported from `@objectstack/spec/data`. Its readers:
- the record page: `deriveRelatedLists` sets `isPrimary` from it (`isMainContentList` is deleted), and `RecordDetailView`'s `isBody` is now `isPrimary`, so plugin-detail's `bodyTablePlacement` receives the spec verdict;
- Studio: `RelatedTablePlacement` (`ObjectGroupInspector.tsx`) offers only relationships with `isPrimary`, and the relationship inspector reads an absent `relatedList` through it;
- the refusal, at `defineStack` and at the door.

`fieldGroupBodyTableRefusal` writes the one refusal sentence both surfaces print.

### The refusal

- `defineStack` (`os validate`, `os build`): `collectRelatedListNameErrors` pushes the sentence for `fieldGroups[i].relatedList`, as a `STACK_CROSS_REFERENCE_INVALID` issue.
- The object write door (`PUT /api/v1/meta/object`, Studio, MCP): `validate-related-list-refs` reports `related-list-group-not-body` (error) at `objects.<name>.fieldGroups[i].relatedList`, so the write answers `422 INVALID_METADATA`. It runs under the closure boundary the rule already documents: a child outside the judged collection is left unjudged, as the name check leaves it. `os explain related-list-group-not-body` has an entry.
- A bare child name names every FK of that child, so it is refused when any of them is not a body table; the remedy then points at `object.field` for the one that is.
- `relatedLists` entries are not judged this way: they order body tables and side cards alike.

Example sentence (from the spec test):
> Object 'lead' fieldGroups[2].relatedList 'task' names a related list that is not a body table: 'task.lead_id' is a side card. A field group's relatedList only positions a body table (a FK declaring relatedList: 'primary', or a master_detail FK that sets inlineEdit and declares no relatedList), so the record page draws nothing at the group for any other list. Set relatedList: 'primary' on that FK, or remove the group's relatedList.

### Describe and docblock

Written on top of #27352's wording (merged as ad3a640e). Only the last sentence of the describe and of the docblock change.

Before (`fieldGroups[i].relatedList` describe, last sentence):
> relatedList: false on the relationship still hides the table.

After:
> It names a body table only (a FK declaring relatedList: 'primary', or a master_detail FK that sets inlineEdit and declares no relatedList): a group naming a side card or a list hidden by relatedList: false draws nothing, so it is refused where the child's fields are known (os validate / os build and the metadata write door), naming the FK and the remedy (set relatedList: 'primary' on it, or remove the group's relatedList).

The docblock says the same, names `isBodyTableRelationship` and the rule `related-list-group-not-body`, and keeps "Body tables no group places keep the record page's default position." `content/docs/references/data/object.mdx` is regenerated. The phrases are pinned in `related-list-body-table.test.ts`, beside #27352's pins in `record-page-describes.test.ts`, which stay green.

`field.zod.ts`'s "A field group's `relatedList` can place it among the field sections" (on `relatedList: 'primary'`) is true as written once this lands, so it is not edited (and it is #27352's line).

### One record page cell moves

A `master_detail` FK that sets `inlineEdit` and declares `relatedList: true` is a side card, as `relatedList`'s description says ("write true to keep it a side card") and as Studio's relationship inspector writes it. `RecordDetailView` used to draw it as a body table. It now moves to the related column. The seat confirmed this reading. Pinned by `RecordDetailView.bodyTablePredicate-27478.test.tsx`.

### ADR-0087 and stored rows

- Disposition: `registered field-group-related-list-side-card-refused`, a D3 semantic entry (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.field-group-related-list-side-card-refused.ts`) with no D2 conversion, because which remedy the author meant (promote the FK, or drop the placement) is not recorded.
- Stored rows: the object parse does not judge this, so a stored `sys_metadata` object row carrying such a group is not rewritten and still loads and registers unchanged. Its record page draws what it drew before, except the one cell above. Its next save through the metadata write door is refused `422` at `fieldGroups[i].relatedList` until fixed, and so is a write of the child that turns a body table a stored group places into a side card (pinned in `runtime-gate.object-writes.test.ts`).
- Census at the change: no example, platform object, dogfood fixture or HotCRM object (hotcrm `47a0666`) declares a field group `relatedList` at all. Deployed metadata was not measured.
- `Metadata-protocol: none` is copied from the order's claim. AGENTS.md reads a refused value as `narrowed`; the conflict is reported to the seat rather than decided here.

### Liveness

- `object.json` `fieldGroups.relatedList`: planned → live (readers `bodyTablePlacement`, `collectRelatedListNameErrors`, `validateRelatedListRefs`).
- `field.json` `relatedList`: evidence re-cited to `deriveRelatedLists` and `isBodyTableRelationship`.

## Why

A group naming a side card saved, published and silently drew nothing, and Studio offered it. Under ruling B the FK is the only source of body-ness, so the group is refused rather than honoured.

## Verification

All on head `78c79004` unless marked, under `os-verify-lock`.

- New or changed tests:
  - `packages/spec/src/data/related-list-body-table.test.ts`: the predicate's verdict table (14 shapes plus null and undefined), the exact refusal sentence, and the describe pins.
  - `packages/spec/src/stack-related-lists-order.test.ts`: `defineStack` refuses a group naming a side card, an inline-edited `master_detail` with `relatedList: true`, a plain `master_detail` and a hidden list, and a mixed bare name; body-table controls pass.
  - `packages/lint/src/validate-related-list-refs.test.ts` and `runtime-gate.object-writes.test.ts`: the door refuses a group naming a side card and publishes it once the FK is primary; a child write that makes a placed body table a side card is refused; the lint sentence equals the `defineStack` sentence word for word.
  - `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts`: `PUT` answers `422` with rule `related-list-group-not-body` at `objects.rl_quote.fieldGroups[0].relatedList`; the control saves.
  - `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.bodyTablePredicate-27478.test.tsx` (mounted page): an inline-edited `master_detail` with `relatedList: true` is a side card; with no `relatedList` it is drawn at its group in the details column.
  - `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectGroupInspector.relatedListPlacement-27054.test.tsx`: Studio offers None plus body tables only, and a stored side-card value shows the not-a-body-table line.
  - `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/__tests__/buildDefaultPageSchema.bodyTables-27055.test.ts`: a group naming a side card promotes nothing.
- Reverse legs (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored to HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty, on `55a063ec`):
  - `RecordDetailView` `isBody` put back to the old inline copy: the mounted test went 1 failed, 1 passed (the control stayed green);
  - the `defineStack` push deleted: `stack-related-lists-order` went 4 failed, 19 passed;
  - the lint finding never pushed: lint went 4 failed, 33 passed.
- Suites: `@objectstack/spec` 839 files, 23799 tests passed; `@objectstack/lint` 177 files, 7607 passed; `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` 279 files passed, 4 skipped; touched ui files 3 files, 22 tests passed; ui `scripts/` 169 files passed, 2 skipped. `check:generated` 14 of 14 up to date.
- Build: `turbo run build --concurrency=2`, 115 of 115 tasks.
- Gates: `dispatch-gates --commands` derives 113; 113 run, all exit 0; `--ran` reconciles 113 derived, 113 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- Dogfood (title has `!` and the narrowing arm): full `@objectstack/dogfood test` exit 0, 350 files passed, 3 skipped (2817 tests passed, 20 skipped).
- `check-changeset-no-major` with this body as the event: exit 0 (level axis: `no (narrowing)` and `none`, no entry above `patch`).

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
